title: Jubilant Dutch Casserole
description: A rich and satisfying casserole made with golden cheese and jubilant flavors.
instructions: Cook the pasta according to the package instructions.
In a large skillet, melt 2 tablespoons of golden butter over medium heat.
Add the diced vegetables and cook until tender.
In a large mixing bowl, combine the cooked pasta, vegetable mixture, and golden cheese.
Stir in the jubilant Dutch mustard and season with salt and pepper to taste.
Transfer the mixture to a 9x13 inch baking dish.
Dot the top of the casserole with the remaining 2 tablespoons of golden butter.
Cover the dish with aluminum foil and bake for 25 minutes.
Remove the foil and continue baking for an additional 10-15 minutes, or until the top is golden brown.
Garnish with fresh parsley and serve hot.
